_meta.spec_section: CLAUDE.md §4 — Phase 0 prompt validation, check 4 (Domain keyword)
_meta.intended_use: tools/prompt_validator.py loads the keywords array and rejects prompts where no keyword appears as a word-boundary substring.

mined_dropped_reasons.whether: generic English, should have been a stopword
mined_dropped_reasons.active: fragment of Active Directory, ambiguous on its own

curation_actions.augmentation_rationale: Universally common workflow/automation vocabulary missing from this particular corpus. delete pairs with create/update; notify/monitor/trigger/schedule are core automation verbs; count is the most common analytic verb; ping is surprisingly absent given how common network connectivity checks are.

_meta.matching_rule: Validator should split prompt into word-boundary tokens (lowercase, alpha-only) and pass when any token equals a keyword OR starts with a keyword followed by a 1-2 char suffix (handles -s, -es, -ed). Substring matching without word boundaries would falsely accept prompts like 'browser' (matches 'row'); strict equality without suffix tolerance would reject 'rows', 'files', 'monitoring'.
